title: ABIDE-II complete-case retention
description: Course activity for Chapter 1 EDA: choose a set of core variables and see how complete-case filtering changes the retained sample overall and within each acquisition site.
instructions: Tick the variables you would require for an analysis. A participant is kept only if every ticked variable is recorded for them. The summary and the chart update immediately, overall and for each acquisition site.
reflectionPrompts: Compare the suggested core set with a selection that adds one or more behavioral questionnaires. How much does the retained sample shrink, and which sites disappear first?
Which acquisition sites are disproportionately affected by requiring the behavioral measures? Use the missingness heatmap above to explain why.

Complete-case filtering can change the composition of the sample, not just its size. Which groups of participants might be over- or under-represented after filtering, and why does that matter for a later analysis?
